verdict.rationale: Lever documents rule-based automation. Its Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates, and Advanced Nurture automates outreach and follow-ups. SMS scheduling is also built in. None of this evidence shows users defining recurring, time-scheduled jobs or workflows, and webhooks are event-driven rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: an explicit recurring/cron-style schedule for workflows, user-configurable schedule cadence, scheduled exports or reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
